welcome_subtitle: A premium lightweight Python MVC framework built from scratch using Python's standard library, now featuring a seamless side-by-side FastAPI integration and a custom ASGI gateway!
features_subtitle: PyFlow comes packed with robust and ready-made solutions to facilitate quick and professional web development in Python.
routing_desc: Supports custom middleware grouping, dynamic path parameter binding (e.g. {id:int}), and RESTful resource routes.
di_desc: Core dependency resolver that simplifies object lifecycles and eliminates tightly coupled code.
orm_desc: Lightweight, powerful ORM model system for easily handling database tables, records, and relationships.
qb_desc: Chained and fluent database query builder, always driving parameterized queries for maximum protection.
validator_desc: Robust validator in core/validator.py supporting required, email, unique, min, and max rules.
transactions_desc: Supports SQL SAVEPOINT nested database transactions to safely handle partial execution failures.
fastapi_desc: Custom ASGI gateway running FastAPI side-by-side on the same port at /api/* with automatic Swagger docs.
api_keys_desc: Laravel Sanctum-like secure SHA-256 tokens supporting dual authentication (JWT and X-API-Key) on API endpoints.
logs_desc: Automatically logs user security events, logins, and settings changes with IP address and User-Agent tracking.
security_desc: CSRF verification, secure PBKDF2 hashing, session fixation defense, and custom CSP security headers.
debug_desc: Diagnostics bar at the page bottom displaying load times, database queries executed, and session variables.
rate_limit_desc: Dynamic IP and session-based rate limiter to protect authentication paths from spamming.
why_desc_1_body: Delivers maximum execution speed and low memory usage without any framework overhead.
why_desc_2_body: Allows building a web frontend alongside highly performant, auto-documented async APIs.
why_desc_3_body: Easily toggle application content and layout language between English and Bengali dynamically.
footer_text: A Premium lightweight custom MVC Framework for professional Python developers.
